subject.title: feat(telegram): handle unknown groups with warn or leave

question: Should OpenClaw add Telegram-specific opt-in unknown-group warn/leave behavior now, and should it apply consistently to normal messages and native commands while excluding wildcard/sender-allowlist misses?
rationale: The feature adds new config and a destructive Telegram Bot API side effect at an authorization boundary, so maintainers need to confirm the product and security semantics before the branch can be accepted.

options.title: Revise Narrow Telegram Feature
options.body: Keep the channel-specific feature but require precise unknown-chat classification, native-command parity, topic-safe sends, docs, and real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Defer To Group Admission Design
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve the broader group-pairing or group-admission contract before adding channel-specific warn/leave config.

options.title: Reject Auto-Leave Surface
options.body: Keep current allowlist/drop behavior and document manual group cleanup instead of adding automatic leave behavior.

recommendation.title: Revise Narrow Telegram Feature
recommendation.body: Keep the channel-specific feature but require precise unknown-chat classification, native-command parity, topic-safe sends, docs, and real Telegram proof before merge.
